customer: Good afternoon, I'm hoping to sell my compact sedan to Northwind Auto, but I've misplaced the title and I live in Brevin. Could you tell me how I'd go about replacing it, and whether that holds up the sale? Thank you kindly for your help.
agent: Thank you for reaching out. Per our article "Getting a duplicate title in Brevin," you can request a duplicate title by mail or at any Brevin motor vehicle office, bringing your registration and a photo ID, and it takes 4 to 6 weeks to arrive. In the meantime you're welcome to get an offer and book an appointment, though we can't complete the purchase until the duplicate arrives. Since offers last a limited time, you may need a new one, and our article "How long is my offer good for?" has more details.
